title: Pure Atlantis Umi
aliases: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon
summary: Pure Atlantis Umi control and Link build, combining classic Umi ocean floodgates with the modern Atlantis sea dragon engine. While Umi is active on the field, the deck restricts the opponent to a single non-WATER monster, negates threats from hand and board, and climbs into devastating Daedalus Link wipes.

summary.title: Starters
points: Fish Sonar searches any Level 7 or lower monster that mentions Umi directly from the Deck, and Special Summons a WATER Normal Monster if Umi is on the field.

Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin searches Umi, an Umi Spell/Trap, or a Kairyu-Shin card from your Deck upon summon, while locking both players into controlling only 1 non-WATER monster while Umi is face-up.
Advent of Atlantis is treated as Umi on field and in GY, places Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon or an Umi card from your Deck, and adds a Level 7 Sea Serpent from GY to hand.
Electric Jellyfish sends an Umi card from hand, Deck, or field to the GY to Special Summon a WATER monster from your hand, and negates a monster effect or Spell Card while Umi is active.
Siren Vortex of Atlantis mills an Atlantis card upon summon and Special Summons a WATER monster from hand when sent to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Fish Sonar or Kairyu-Shin
steps: Activate Fish Sonar to add Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin from your Deck to your hand.
Normal Summon Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin and activate its effect to search Advent of Atlantis (or A Legendary Ocean).
Activate Advent of Atlantis, placing Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon from your Deck onto your Field Zone.
Kairyu-Shin's floodgate immediately takes effect under Atlantis, limiting the opponent to a single non-WATER monster.
Set Daedalus Maelstrom or Call of Atlantis to protect your board with omni-negation and non-WATER board wipes.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage is a Link-4 boss that revives up to three Atlantis monsters on summon and sends every card on the field to the GY except your Umi cards.
Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus summons an Atlantis monster from your Deck and can reset the opponent's entire hand when linked.
Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin forces each player to send face-up non-WATER monsters to the GY until they control only 1 while Umi is face-up.

Fisherman of Legend Special Summons itself from hand when an opponent monster attacks or activates an effect while Umi is active, destroying an opponent monster and returning to hand in the End Phase.
Monster Arms of Atlantis negates an opponent monster effect by banishing itself from the GY while Umi is active.
Worldsea Dragon Zealantis temporarily banishes all monsters on the field and re-summons them, turning the opponent's monsters into easy battle targets under Umi.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon acts as a Field Spell that reduces the Levels of WATER monsters by 1, reduces the material requirements for Daedalus Link Summons by 1, and recurs itself from the GY.
Call of Atlantis adds an Atlantis monster from Deck to hand and negates an opponent monster effect if Atlantis is face-up.
Daedalus Maelstrom acts as a Counter Trap to negate a summon and destroy all non-WATER monsters on the field if an Atlantis card is face-up.
Dominus Impulse negates an opponent's Special Summoning effect, playable from the hand if you control no cards.

allow.Dominus Impulse: In the page's build: its lock stops LIGHT, EARTH and WIND monsters, and this deck is all WATER.
allow.Marincess Coral Anemone: Generic WATER Link-2 in the page's Extra Deck: revives Siren Vortex or Monster Arms.
allow.Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron: WATER Link-3 in the page's Extra Deck, made from a Daedalus Link and two more monsters.

Warchief of Atlantis
Newest support. Discards itself to search an Atlantis Spell/Trap; comes back from the GY while you control Umi.
Siren Vortex of Atlantis
Newest support. Summoned: mills an Atlantis card; sent to the GY, summons a WATER from the hand.
Monster Arms of Atlantis
Newest support. Summoned: revives an Atlantis monster; banishes itself to negate a monster effect.
Fisherman of Legend
Newest support. Joins when their monster acts or attacks with Umi out, destroys a monster, and returns to the hand.
Coralianectes, the Luminous Cradle Dragon

Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin
While Umi is on the field, each player keeps only one non-WATER monster; searches Umi or a Kairyu-Shin card.
Electric Jellyfish
Sends an Umi to summon a WATER from the hand; negates with Umi on the field.
Advent of Atlantis
Newest support. Counts as Umi; places Atlantis or Umi from the Deck, and searches a Level 7 Sea Serpent from the GY.
Call of Atlantis
Newest support. Searches an Atlantis monster and negates a monster with Atlantis out.

A Legendary Ocean

Fish Sonar

Dominus Impulse
